evidence.quote: PURPOSE:To promote bleaching action and to shorten processing time by processing a photosensitive material with a processing solution having bleaching power in the presence of at least one of specified compounds and at least one of other specified compounds.
PURPOSE:To eliminate fogging and to make improvement in desilvering property by incorporating the ferric complex salt of a specific compd. into the bleaching soln.

PURPOSE:To enable rapid desilvering as well as to maintain the activity of a processing soln. and to ensure uniform finish by incorporating a specified compd. into a color photographic sensitive material and specifying the amt. of a tank soln. circulated per 1min in a processing bath having bleaching capacity.
